name: bug
description: Something does not work as docs/human/severity.md or the plan says it should.

name: sev-3
description: Severity 3 (docs/human/severity.md): needs a triage decision before launch.

name: triaged
description: Has a triage comment in the fixed form from docs/human/severity.md.

name: upstream
description: The cause is in Synapse, the PDS, Tap or Ozone, not in this repository.

name: security-review
description: Touches auth, identity, crypto, egress or personal data: needs a security review.

name: large-pr
description: Over 800 changed source lines; the body's Large PR: line says why (D3).

name: kind/fix
description: Kind of change (D2): corrects behaviour that was wrong.

name: kind/refactor
description: Kind of change (D2): new structure, same behaviour.

name: kind/build
description: Kind of change (D2): CI, tooling, guards or dependencies.
